declare
 temp boolean;
 chk_zip varchar2(1) ;
begin
/* 
 if :new_don_emp.city is null then
 show_error('14102');
 end if;
*/
if :new_don_emp.city is not null then
 begin
 select ''
 into chk_zip
 from valid_city_state 
 where city = :new_don_emp.city ;

 when no_data_found then

 select ''
 into chk_zip
 from valid_city_state 
 where city like :new_don_emp.city || '%'; 
 show_error('16040'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then

 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then

 if temp = FALSE then
 go_item('new_don_emp.city');
 end if;
 end;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 --next_item;
 null;
 end;
 :new_don_emp.zip := NULL;
end if;
end;

declare
 c_employer_id varchar2(10);
 c_err_flg varchar2(1);
 c_err_msg varchar2(200);
 v_err_flg varchar2(1);

begin
 v_err_flg := 'N';
 if :new_don_emp.emp_name is null then
 v_err_flg := 'Y';
 show_error('0080', ':Employer Name');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if nvl(:new_don_emp.intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y' AND
 (:new_don_emp.intl_city is null OR :new_don_emp.intl_country_name is null ) then
 v_err_flg := 'Y';
 show_error('0080', ':Intl Address'); 
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if nvl(:new_don_emp.intl_addr_flag,'Y') = 'N' AND
 (:new_don_emp.city is null or :new_don_emp.zip is null ) then
 v_err_flg := 'Y';
 show_error('0080', ':Local Address');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :new_don_emp.eff_date is null then 
 v_err_flg := 'Y';
 show_error('0080', ':Eff Date');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 
 if v_err_flg = 'N' then
 don_common_pack.generate_new_id('DNEMP',c_employer_id,
 c_err_flg,c_err_msg);
 --message('c_err ' || c_err_msg);pause;
 :system.message_level := '25';

 insert into donor_employers(
 employer_id, employer_name, usps_id,
 eff_date, term_date, chapter_id, program_id,
 intl_city, intl_state, intl_postal_code, -- Added on 05/20/2011;Ashok;IM:5496
 intl_country_name, intl_addr_flag)
 --values( c_employer_id, :new_don_emp.emp_name, :new_don_emp.usps_id,
 -- :new_don_emp.eff_date, :new_don_emp.term_date, 'WAD', :banner.prog_name);
 values( c_employer_id, :new_don_emp.emp_name, :new_don_emp.usps_id,
 :new_don_emp.eff_date, :new_don_emp.term_date, :global.chapter_id, :banner.prog_name,
 :new_don_emp.intl_city, :new_don_emp.intl_state, :new_don_emp.intl_postal_code,
 :new_don_emp.intl_country_name, nvl(:new_don_emp.intl_addr_flag,'N') ); 
 commit;
 show_error('9163');
 :system.message_level:= '10';
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS

begin
 if :ctrl.search_type = 'L' then
 set_block_property( 'donor_employers', default_where,
 'chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and upper(employer_name) like ''%'' || :ctrl.name || ''%''' );
 elsif :ctrl.search_type='M' then
 set_block_property( 'donor_employers', default_where, 
 'chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and upper(employer_name) like :ctrl.name || ''%''' );
 else
 set_block_property( 'donor_employers', default_where, 
 'chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and soundex(upper((employer_name)) like soundex(:ctrl.name)');
 end if;

 item_change('ctrl.name','D');
 item_change('ctrl.search_type','D');
 item_change('ctrl.retrieve','D');
end;
